summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Brookfield Private Equity Fund LP reporting an unregistered sale of limited partnership units under Item 3.02 and providing a periodic net asset value update under Item 8.01. On April 1, 2026, the fund sold 176,613 Class S units ($4.66M), 107,374 Class I units ($2.84M), and 1,877 Class B-2 units ($50K) in a continuous private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. The Transactional NAV as of March 31, 2026, ranged from $26.36 to $26.81 per unit depending on class. No special situation event—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, restructuring, or delisting is involved. A routine capital raise and NAV disclosure with no structural changes or governance implications.
